entry.title: Pause to watch and listen outside
entry.summary: During time outdoors, pause over the leaves, birds or passing life your baby notices. A few names and some quiet can be enough.
entry.cue: Something outside holds their gaze or makes them turn to listen.
detail: The authors describe the movement of leaves and the sounds of birds as things a baby can enjoy. We can name a tree, dog or vehicle, then leave room to look and listen together.

references.locator: Watching leaves, talking on walks and quiet listening

ageContext.bookAge: The outdoors passage begins from the first month and continues into walking; no endpoint for noticing/naming.
ageContext.readiness: The baby attends to outdoor sights and sounds.
ageContext.note: The activity may continue while it fits your child’s interest and current skills; the source ages are guides.

displayContext.footer: You don’t need a different home. Start with what you have.
displayContext.colophon: Original summaries inspired by The Montessori Baby and The Montessori Toddler. Open any idea for its book references. The illustration is an invitation to explore, rather than a room to reproduce. Follow your child’s pace.
displayContext.referenceNote: Paraphrased for this companion. Illustrations are original and illustrative.
